title.narrative: Bridge of Hope Project in Syria 2025

description.narrative: Dispatch 700 trucks loaded with relief assistance (more than 45,222 food baskets; more than 266,971 cartons of dates; more than 14,080 shelter kits; 198,856 items of clothing; 16,000 blankets of 4.5 kg; 9,024 blankets of 4 kg), distributed through the implementing partner.
Dispatch of 700 trucks loaded with relief assistance consisting of food baskets, dates, shelter kits, clothing, and blankets, distributed through the implementing partner.
The most vulnerable families receive the relief assistance.
Disbursement for "Bridge of Hope Project in Syria 2025" in Syria, implemented by Takaful Alsham Organization
